name: aliasflare
description: Self-hosted email aliases (SimpleLogin / addy.io style) on Cloudflare Workers. Deploy-to-Cloudflare button plus two Email Routing settings, free tier, reply from alias, verification-code extraction, MCP for AI agents.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DOMAIN.description: Your domain on Cloudflare that receives alias mail, e.g. `example.com`. Several domains: comma-separated, the first is the default.

DESTINATION.description: Your real inbox. It must be a **verified destination address** in Email Routing (Dashboard → Email → Email Routing → Destination addresses).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Password for the web dashboard, API and MCP. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional, for replying/sending from aliases on the free plan. Get a free key at [resend.com](https://resend.com) (3,000 emails/month). Enter `none` to skip.
